label: DeepSeek V4 Flash
notes: Since 2026-08-03 the **release build DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731** is the source of truth (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, MIT). The official model card marks the preview, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash, as superseded; this project no longer references it.

The release and preview GGUFs have **identical tensor layout**: 1328 tensors, arch string deepseek4, block_count 43, and equal byte sizes tensor for tensor. Only the weight values differ, so the ds4 inference path needs no change.

compress_ratios has 46 entries in the official config.json (44 in the preview), but antirez's converted GGUF metadata still carries 44; ds4 validates only the first n_layers (43) entries and requires length >= 43, so both pass.

The model card states 304B (284B for the preview). The extra ~20B is the DSpark speculative decoding module, **packaged separately** as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-support.gguf (5.6 GiB) and absent from the main weight file -- which is why the main GGUF is byte for byte the same size as the preview.

layer_weight_bytes / shared_weight_bytes are **measured**: summed tensor by tensor from the GGUF tensor directory (blk.N.* counted as layer weights, everything else as shared), reading only the header over HTTP Range. Self-check: layer + shared + data_start == file size, exactly, for both variants.

The previously registered 81 GiB / 1 GiB were estimates and were off by a visible margin (measured: 79.249 GiB / 1.510 GiB). Within shared, token_embd (1.06 GB) lands on the first stage and output (0.56 GB) on the last, so a wrong estimate skews the pipeline-parallel plan directly.

speculative.weight_bytes lands on the **last stage only** -- the draft module consumes the hidden states of layers 40/41/42 -- unlike shared_weight_bytes, which every stage loads. available=false means the weights are confirmed fetchable but the engine forward pass is not implemented yet (see docs/dspark-design.md).

DSpark is shelved (decided 2026-08-03): the code and analysis stay in the tree but are not enabled, speculative.available=false, there are zero production call sites, and the G_DSPARK gate defaults to SKIP (set HOMEAI_DSPARK_GATE=1 to run it). Read the shelving note at the top of docs/dspark-design.md before restarting the work.
